purpose: Separate preregistered causal sensor-quiet rest-candidate variant; exact baseline fixtures and acceptance retained
candidate: Unleaked integration plus one velocity/carry reset per newly qualified sensor-quiet episode
onset_policy: Every valid armed sample is integrated immediately. A rest candidate clears state only once per quiet episode, never continuously overrides integration while rest-latched; a nonquiet sample permits the next quiet episode.
control_policy: Same explicit arming, startup/recovery/cadence/output gates as baseline. Recenter starts quiet-latched. No new time limit.
oracle_policy: Oracle changes only integration acceleration. Sensor-quiet classifier still receives actual Fusion residual, measured gyro and specific force, never truth velocity or truth rest.
expected_tradeoffs: May correct rest residual only after measured residual becomes quiet enough
A constant-speed coast can satisfy all quiet criteria and be reset incorrectly
An onset below all quiet thresholds is integrated immediately but may not create a new quiet episode for a later rest correction
An acceleration bias can remain below the quiet threshold for an entire episode
This single heuristic cannot establish a universal impossibility or qualify a product
parameters: Bench hypotheses set before this variant executes, not device-calibrated or fitted to individual cases
execution_policy: Freeze separate source and runner before build/execution. Preserve all baseline and follow-on failures. No changes to baseline fixture generation, acceptance or outputs.
